subject: bug or feature: tbl_df vs tbl_sqlite

messages.author: 03290ff051991093
messages.subject: bug or feature: tbl_df vs tbl_sqlite
parts:
Not sure whether this is a bug or a feature. Code is below, and I'm getting different output, dependent on whether I'm using data.frame or SQLite. 

library("dplyr")
library("magrittr")
db <- src_sqlite("testing.sqlite3", create = TRUE)
iris_tbl <-
  copy_to(
    db,
    iris,
    temporary = FALSE)
do.fn <- function(x)
  cbind(x$Species[1], mean(x$Sepal.Length, trim = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE))

iris %>%
  tbl_df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  do(do.fn)

iris_tbl %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  do(do.fn)

The data.frame output looks like this: 
[[1]]
     [,1]     [,2]
[1,] "setosa" "5" 

[[2]]
     [,1]         [,2] 
[1,] "versicolor" "5.9"

[[3]]
     [,1]        [,2] 
[1,] "virginica" "6.5"

And the SQLite output looks like this: 
Source: local data frame [150 x 2]

   Species              DO
1   setosa       setosa, 5
2   setosa versicolor, 5.9
3   setosa  virginica, 6.5
4   setosa            NULL

7   setosa            NULL
8   setosa            NULL
9   setosa            NULL
10  setosa            NULL
